basic_info.description: Top floor, light-filled Noe condo w/ downtown and Twin Peaks views! Located perfectly to stroll delightful 24th st shops in one direction and bustling Mission restaurants in the other, the ultimate choose-your-own-adventure lifestyle awaits.        Offering an ideal floor plan & marvelous period detailing, the living space includes a spacious kitchen leading to dining & living room w/oversized windows, high ceilings, fireplace and Juliet balcony. Hallway leads to 2 impeccably maintained baths with vintage tile and 2 sizable bedrooms with colorful hillside views out back. Plentiful closet space peppers the hallway and both bedrooms. Downstairs, the landscaped shared yard enjoys plenty of sunshine.          In- unit washer dryer, 1 car parking & tons of storage completed the package. New roof, Marvin dual paned windows, Nest thermostat and system updates throughout. Conveniently located near Dolores Park, public transportation & highway access, this home is a quiet private perch for enjoying the best of SF.
